lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly regular 2D grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs at right angles, forming a matrix where blobs serve as nodes at each intersection point.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 10-12 small, high-luminance blobs distributed primarily across the dorsal half of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small, irregularly spaced spots, and the caudal fin shows distinct high-intensity spotting on both the upper and lower lobes.
